configuration.title: Editor Switcher
configuration.onCloseKeepGroupFocus.desc: Keep group focus on close. If true, the quick pick dialog selection will attempt to retain focus on the nearest tab in the same group after closing a highlighted tab. Otherwise, the dialog selection will move between groups on close based on the selected extension tab selection strategy.
configuration.onCloseSelectTabStrategy.d: On close tab select strategy: Controls which tab is selected after closing a highlighted tab via the quick pick dialog. This only affects the quick pick dialog, and it does not impact built-in editor tab selection if the closed tab was active.
configuration.onCloseSelectTabStrategy.s: Move focus to the next tab in the quick pick dialog.
Move focus to the prior tab in the quick pick dialog.
